description: This file implements a PHP class for an Oracle database driver via ODBC, including methods for metadata retrieval, connection handling, and session configuration within the ADOdb database abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_odbc_oracle
classes.description: PHP class for Oracle database driver via ODBC, providing connection, metadata, and session management functionalities.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_odbc_oracle
classes.description: A record set class extending the ODBC Oracle record set, for handling query results.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves the list of table names from the Oracle database schema.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for columns of a specified table in the Oracle database.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Oracle database using ODBC with provided credentials.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Oracle database using ODBC.
